answer: Tie influence to a single indivisible reputation pearl earned only by climbing a terrace of timestamped, independently-witnessed work, bound to one key's history and not to headcount. A crystal-clear provenance ledger links every new account to the capital and vouchers that funded it, so a swarm forged from one source shares one pearl split thinner per clone, never multiplied. Each terrace step costs real escrowed stake, slashed if a cluster is proven linked: faking N identities pays N times yet gains one voice.
